rationale: The approved durable UR permits Brownfield routing, but Compact Delivery is ineligible because no completed Brownfield Review with a stored quick_task decision is supplied. Verified Change is also ineligible because ownership is distributed across three canonical owners and propagation is not deterministic. The bounded product-semantics change has no runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, API, CLI, release, or cross-host impact, so structured_slice is the proportional benchmark candidate rather than structured_delivery.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Brownfield Review is not evidenced as completed; lifecycle is brownfield_candidate.
No stored quick_task Mode/Slice Decision is supplied.
canonical_owner_count is 3, so the one-owner Verified Change requirement fails.
derived_path_count is 4 while deterministic_propagation is false.
Baseline is clean and validation is deterministic.
